request.query: For a commutative ring R and algebra A, an algebraic element has a nonzero R scalar multiple integral over R; fraction field scalar restriction

items.name: IsAlgebraic.exists_integral_multiple
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {z : A},
  IsAlgebraic R z → ∃ y, y ≠ 0 ∧ IsIntegral R (y • z)

items.name: IsAlgebraic
items.type: (R : Type u) → {A : Type v} → [inst : CommRing R] → [inst_1 : Ring A] → [Algebra R A] → A → Prop

items.name: Algebra.isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u} {A : Type v} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra K A],
  Algebra.IsAlgebraic K A ↔ Algebra.IsIntegral K A

items.name: Algebra.IsAlgebraic
items.type: (R : Type u) → (A : Type v) → [inst : CommRing R] → [inst_1 : Ring A] → [Algebra R A] → Prop

items.name: Algebra.isAlgebraic_def
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A],
  Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A ↔ ∀ (x : A), IsAlgebraic R x

items.name: IsAlgebraic.smul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {a : A},
  IsAlgebraic R a → ∀ (r : R), IsAlgebraic R (r • a)

items.name: isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u} {A : Type v} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra K A] {x : A},
  IsAlgebraic K x ↔ IsIntegral K x

items.name: IsIntegral
items.type: (R : Type u_1) → {A : Type u_3} → [inst : CommRing R] → [inst_1 : Ring A] → [Algebra R A] → A → Prop
